Assertion.description: A scope's time-bounded stance toward a Proposition.
Assertion.title: Assertion

CanonChangeSet.description: An immutable, approved group of append-only Canon operations.
CanonChangeSet.title: CanonChangeSet

CanonLedgerEntry.description: One atomic, approved JSONL entry in the Canon Ledger.
CanonLedgerEntry.title: CanonLedgerEntry

ChangeSetOperation.description: One append-only operation against the Canon assertion history.
ChangeSetOperation.title: ChangeSetOperation

Chapter.description: A chapter's story position and reader-facing order.
Chapter.title: Chapter

ChapterEntityOccurrence.description: One resolved Entity's navigational presence in an approved Chapter.
ChapterEntityOccurrence.title: ChapterEntityOccurrence

ChapterSummary.description: Non-Canon navigation memory for one approved Chapter revision.
ChapterSummary.title: ChapterSummary

ChapterSummaryDependency.description: The exact Chapter Summary revision consumed by a Volume Summary.
ChapterSummaryDependency.title: ChapterSummaryDependency

ChapterTrace.description: Non-Canon Entity mention and occurrence index for one Chapter revision.
ChapterTrace.title: ChapterTrace

Document.description: A versioned Canon or structure document inside a novel project.
Document.title: Document

Entity.description: A long-lived narrative object addressed only through an opaque UUID.
Entity.title: Entity

EntityAlias.description: A time-bounded name for an entity; never an association key.
EntityAlias.title: EntityAlias

EntityMention.description: One revision-bound prose span and its explicit Entity resolution.
EntityMention.title: EntityMention

Event.description: A story-world occurrence and the order in which readers encounter it.
Event.title: Event

EventEdge.description: A directed semantic relation between two distinct events.
EventEdge.title: EventEdge

Proposition.description: A claim-shaped statement that intentionally carries no truth value.
Proposition.title: Proposition

Qualifier.description: An immutable scalar qualifier attached to a proposition.
Qualifier.title: Qualifier

SourceRef.description: A revision-aware source pointer that survives ordinary text movement.
SourceRef.title: SourceRef

StoryTime.description:
A calendar-neutral position on a story timeline.

Narrative order deliberately does not belong to this value object. It is a
property of the chapter or event through which readers encounter the event.
StoryTime.title: StoryTime

Volume.description: An explicit, stable Volume boundary over existing Chapter IDs.
Volume.title: Volume

VolumeSummary.description: Non-Canon aggregation over one Volume's Chapter Summaries.
VolumeSummary.title: VolumeSummary
